name: lyft
strip_regex: <tr[^>]*>(?:(?!</tr>).)*?(?:ride pass|Add a tip|Lyft Cash back|100% of tips go to drivers|Promos-Large)(?:(?!</tr>).)*?</tr>
notes: Removed from a Lyft ride receipt: the ride pass and Lyft Cash promo rows, the add a tip module, and the two footer blocks that carry the in app help pointer and the California regulator registration. Kept verbatim: the fare table with every line and the total, the payment line, the pickup and dropoff rows, the driver thanks line and the ride date.
